title: Heard: five ideas for the assistant and the log

text: One, relaying every prompt automatically: I agree, and a hook can do it mechanically so the assistant cannot forget; I am checking whether our existing hook already sees your prompts. Two, skill hooks: same mechanism. Three, the log evolving from raw words into refined items: already with the dev bar minion. Four, your speech transcribed live into the log, verbatim and timestamped, with optional audio: Whisper and the Dictate component make this buildable now; it goes in right after the chat tab lands. Five, a play button that reads an item aloud: small, the browser can speak; same follow-up.
